jobs.description: Skip to content Akeyless Agentic Runtime Authority Control What AI Agents Can Do at Runtime Evaluate intent and policy at the moment of action, block destructive or out-of-scope activity before execution, and maintain full traceability to the agent and originating user. Get a Demo TRUSTED BY LEADING ENTERPRISES, INVESTORS, AND PARTNERS Akeyless Agentic Runtime Authority in Action Welcome to the Akeyless Runtime Authority demo. Akeyless secures more than twenty billion machine and agent identity interactions every month. In this demo, you'll see Akeyless Runtime Authority in action, enabling credential free access for AI agents, coercing real time authorization and policy controls, protecting sensitive data from exposure, guiding agent behavior within security guardrails, and providing complete auditability for every agent action. In this environment, my AI agent has access to several enterprise systems, AWS, two databases, GitHub, and HubSpot. But the agent does not know any credentials for those systems. It only knows how to communicate with the Achilles gateway. For this demo, we will focus on the employee database. The database contains an employee table, and one of the columns contains employee salary information. As an administrator, I created a policy that prevents the agent from exposing salary data. Now I will ask the agent what it can access. The agent discovers the available systems through a keyless, and as we can see, it discovers that it has access to the databases AWS, GitHub, and HubSpot. Next, I will ask it to inspect the employee database. The agent queries the database through the gateway and finds the employee table. Now I will ask the agent to show me the employee table. The agent first tries the obvious query, select asterisk from employee, but Akeyless blocks the request because the query would expose salary information which violates the policy. The important part is what happens next. The agent understands that the salary data is restricted, adjusts its query, and requests only the allowed columns. This time, Akeyless approves a request, and the agent returns the employee data without exposing salary information. Finally, we can go back to Akeyless and see the full audit trail. We see the approved discovery query, the blocked query, and the modified query that excluded salary data. That is a keyless runtime authority. No secrets on the agent, no direct access to enterprise systems, real time policy enforcement, and full traceability for every AI agent action. Thank you for watching this demo. If you're looking to secure AI agent identities and govern agent access to enterprise systems, request a customized demo at aculess. Io. Let AI Agents Act Without Giving Up Control Define what agents can do, then enforce those boundaries at runtime. Keep agent behavior aligned with approved intent and policy. Securely Accelerate Agent Adoption Deploy agents against production databases and cloud infrastructure safely. Stop Unauthorized Agent Actions Continuously evaluate intent and block actions outside approved policy. Prevent Sensitive Data Exposure Regulated data never enters the agent’s context, even on authorized queries. Prove AI Compliance Trace every action to a policy decision and the user behind it. Valid Identity Can Still Lead to Unauthorized Agent Actions Traditional access controls determine what an identity is allowed to access, but they don’t evaluate whether an agent’s next action matches the task it was given. An agent can hold legitimate permissions and still delete data, change configurations, or expose sensitive information. At agent speed, post-action detection is already too late. Bring Agent Activity Under Your Control Every agent request is brokered through the Akeyless Gateway, where intent, policy, data exposure, and audit are enforced in a single path. Enforce Intent-Aware Policy on Every Action Evaluate the semantic intent of each request against the originating prompt and your policies. Destructive or out-of-scope actions are blocked at the Gateway, before execution. If needed, any live session can be ended instantly with a one-click kill switch. Stop risky behavior without stopping legitimate work. Give Agents Only the Data They Need Inspect responses before they reach the agent and apply your data policies in real time. Define what each agent is allowed to see, and redact PII, PHI, financial records, secrets, and other protected information before it enters the agent’s context. Protect sensitive data even when the action is authorized. Maintain Full Forensic Traceability Capture every agent action in a single immutable record: originating prompt, classified intent, policy verdict, session, and final action on the target. Every action traces back to the human who initiated it. Speed investigations and produce audit-ready evidence. Trigger Automated Remediation Send enriched Runtime Authority events to your existing SIEM, SOAR, and IT operations tools with the context needed to act. Use flagged activity to trigger credential rotation, revoke access, or open a remediation workflow automatically. Contain incidents without waiting on a ticket.
